fnol_text: My name is Chloe Santos and I live at 542 Willow Way, Dover, DE 19993. You can reach me on (555) 938-6557 or chloe.santos@example.com. On 9 April 2025 the Calder River overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2025-00021. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Santos on (555) 938-6557 to acknowledge the claim. Chloe confirmed the loss date as 9 April 2025.
Site visit to 542 Willow Way. Neighbour Leila Khan was present and confirmed the timeline.
